name: kalmia
description: Kalmia traces your AI agents and finds what went wrong. This plugin connects the Kalmia MCP server (query traces, read root-cause verdicts and issues, run investigations and sweeps) and adds a skill that sets up Kalmia tracing in a codebase.

api_key.title: Kalmia API key
api_key.description: A read-and-write workspace API key (starts with kal_live_). Create one free at https://www.kalmia.dev/sign-up, under Settings > API keys.
